## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `python -m build`

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No real webhook URLs, tokens, private messages, or personal data are included
- [ ] Network behavior is covered by offline tests
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated when behavior changes
- [ ] The change is focused and ready to squash
